boundaries.mutationSubstrate: exact registered PPTX bytes plus checksum-pinned external manifest; single text object copy-on-write
boundaries.identitySelection: opaque business ID to exact slidePart and shapeId; fingerprints verify only
boundaries.commitOrder: materialize, QA, hash and manifest verification, candidate File/manifest/Work registration, final authoritative head CAS, Session refresh, real readback
boundaries.idempotency: durable project/task/call ledger and existing Runtime checkpoints
boundaries.unknownOutcome: block further writes and reconcile; no automatic candidate regeneration
boundaries.postCommitCancellation: retain committed fact in Host ledger and Trace; stop Provider loop

limitations: Only simple single-run text objects are editable.
Detached or uncertain candidates remain available for reconciliation; no recovery UI or automated garbage collection was added.
Runtime replay of the same call after a live revision refresh may return call_id_conflict; durable mutation replay never creates another revision.
No macOS real-device acceptance or new UI acceptance was claimed.
Existing Vite CJS and chunk-size warnings remain non-blocking.
